company.shortDescription: Converge Bio integrates Generative AI with biological data.
company.description: Converge Bio integrates Generative AI with biological data. Converge Bio mission is to empower biotech and pharmaceutical companies to discover and develop more effective drugs faster, utilizing the power of Large Language Models (LLMs) specifically trained on biological languages.

productsAndServices.description: An AI platform for antibody design, screening, and optimization, supporting de novo design, affinity maturation, humanization, and developability assessment across multiple antibody formats.
productsAndServices.name: ConvergeAB™

productsAndServices.description: An AI platform that analyzes single-cell and bulk RNA-seq data to identify disease-associated targets, biomarkers, patient subgroups, and therapeutic hypotheses.
productsAndServices.name: ConvergeCELL™

productsAndServices.description: A generative AI platform for optimizing gene expression and therapeutic protein production by designing codons, UTRs, promoters, and terminators.
productsAndServices.name: ConvergeGEO™

productsAndServices.description: A managed generative AI platform for life-science R&D that combines biological foundation models with applications for prediction, explainability, and generation.
productsAndServices.name: Converge Computational Lab

insights.title: Hybrid therapeutic platform
insights.statement: Converge Bio combines ConvergeCELL™ with ConvergeAB™.
insights.implication: The company is positioned as a biotechnology platform with both a physical therapeutic-delivery modality and an AI-assisted discovery layer, rather than as a standalone AI software vendor.
caveats: Product descriptions are profile claims and do not establish clinical efficacy.

insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
